announcements.headline: Kroonstad Update & Proposed Rights Consolidation
announcements.insight: Following October's court sanction, this update details a proposed rights consolidation. Shareholders should monitor the implementation of this capital restructuring step.

announcements.headline: Successful Kroonstad Appeals and Issue of Shares
announcements.insight: Following management changes in October, shares were issued after successful appeals for the Kroonstad mining right. This resolves a key regulatory hurdle identified in July.

announcements.headline: Management Changes
announcements.insight: Lexington Gold Ltd announces management changes. This follows recent engagement for a JORC target upgrade and mining right acceptance, suggesting operational adjustments.

announcements.headline: Shango engaged for Kroonstad JORC target upgrade
announcements.insight: Lexington Gold engaged Shango to upgrade JORC targets at Kroonstad. This follows the formal acceptance of a mining right application for the Jelani JV in June.

announcements.headline: Updated Corporate Presentation
announcements.insight: The updated corporate presentation follows the formal acceptance of the mining right application in June. Shareholders should monitor for further operational updates regarding the Jelani JV.

announcements.headline: Formal Acceptance of Mining Right App Re:Jelani JV
announcements.insight: Lexington Gold Ltd has formally accepted a mining right application regarding its Jelani JV. This marks a procedural step in the joint venture's development.
